  "repair_strategy": "Change the attribute to a boolean presence by removing the value, making it data-checkbox-exclusive. This allows the script to detect the checkbox as exclusive and clear other checkboxes in the same group when selected.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "index.html",
      "sha256": "6828d82d86a82e3e4e9364d8442eedcafd0b8f0740235e0d231082ffcd75878e",
      "before": "<input class=\"nhsuk-checkboxes__input\" id=\"symptoms-none\" name=\"symptoms[none]\" type=\"checkbox\" value=\"yes\" data-checkbox-exclusive=\"\" data-checkbox-exclusive-group=\"symptoms\">",
      "after": "<input class=\"nhsuk-checkboxes__input\" id=\"symptoms-none\" name=\"symptoms[none]\" type=\"checkbox\" value=\"yes\" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group=\"symptoms\">"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Keyboard and mouse users can now select the exclusive 'No symptoms' option and have any previously selected symptom choices automatically cleared, providing correct exclusive choice behavior and satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard operability and 4.1.2 name, role, value requirements.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "The change alters the attribute value; if any other script depended on the empty string value, it could be affected, though no such usage is evident.",
    "Ensuring the exclusive behavior remains intact for the contact group (which already uses the correct boolean form) is necessary."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify that selecting 'No symptoms' via keyboard (Tab/Space) or mouse clears any previously selected symptom checkboxes.",
    "Verify that selecting a symptom checkbox after 'No symptoms' clears the 'No symptoms' checkbox.",
    "Confirm that form data reflects the correct values after each interaction.",
    "Ensure the contact group's exclusive 'Do not contact me' checkbox continues to work as expected.",
    "Check that no visual or functional regressions are introduced."
  ]
}
